svg.title: Red Floor Panel
svg.desc: Interpretive study after an actually inspected primary reference. Geometry and interpretive screen colour approximate. Schematic silhouette of the actual photographed FLOOR PROJECTION. All four observed panel corners retained, floor and mounting shadows omitted. Plan outline and rectified aspect are not asserted; excluded from physical scaling. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of red; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://ellsworthkelly.org/work/red-floor-panel/; catalogue record ek-835; inspected2026-10-27. Pure editable vector study, not photographic facsimile.
